cwe_name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in a Cookie

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The function reads cookie values that may contain sensitive information, but CWE-315 specifically requires storage, not just reading. The storage mechanism (createCookie function) is present but not part of this candidate.

connection.evidence: The function reads from document.cookie and returns values that are used for authentication (password) and connection parameters (host, port) in RFB functions

diff_causality.evidence: Adding this cookie reading function enables the consumption of potentially sensitive cookie data. Without it, the application could not read cookie-based configuration values.

security_control.required_control: Encryption or secure storage of sensitive cookie data
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-315 requires that sensitive information in cookies be encrypted or otherwise protected from cleartext exposure
existing_controls_checked: createCookie function stores values in cleartext
readCookie function reads values without decryption
security_control.deficiency_evidence: The cookie storage and retrieval mechanism operates entirely in cleartext, but this candidate only demonstrates the reading aspect, not the storage deficiency

concrete_impact.evidence: Sensitive authentication data could be exposed if cookies are intercepted, but the evidence shows reading functionality rather than demonstrated exposure

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the application would lose the ability to read cookie-based configuration values, preventing consumption of potentially sensitive cookie data.
supporting_evidence: Function reads from document.cookie which may contain sensitive authentication data
Cookie values are used for password, host, and port configuration in RFB connections
No encryption or protection is applied to the cookie values during reading
contradicting_evidence: CWE-315 specifically addresses storage, but this candidate only demonstrates reading functionality
The actual storage mechanism (createCookie) is not part of this candidate
unresolved_facts: Whether sensitive information is actually stored in cookies in this codebase
Whether the createCookie function is used to store sensitive data
Whether cookie values are properly sanitized before being set
